arms: 32 independent concurrent cold lookups with two UIDs each
32 concurrent callers joining one cold UID
same 64 distinct UIDs in one legal cross-target page
observations: cohort adapter entry/exit and UID/target counts

late cancellation must not publish stale proof; all goroutines and nodes join
actual independent admission must never exceed sixteen
no artificial delay in measured arms
startup failure is setup failure, not presence timeout
no automatic retries or workload amplification
